name: @w6w-apps/iclosed
description: Manage iClosed sales-call scheduling: contacts, booked calls, deals, products, transactions and custom fields.

w6w.longDescription:
iClosed is scheduling and CRM software built for sales calls: prospects book a call through a qualifying form, closers work the call, and the result is recorded as an outcome and a deal.

This app covers the public API end to end: create, update and search contacts and their notes; list, book, reschedule and cancel calls and read the open slots for an event; record call outcomes, deals, products and payment transactions; and read or write the custom fields and answers that qualify a lead.

Authentication is an API key from Settings → Developer → API Keys (Business or Enterprise plan). Health checks track iClosed's own status page and an unsigned reachability probe of the API.
